notes.text: Rautenstrauch-Joest-Museum, Inventarbuch 8, page 138 (stable citation https://doi.org/10.11588/diglit.78032#0138). The printed headings are Nr., Gegenstand, Herkunft, Erwerbung and Bemerkungen. Entries 46889 and 46890 are consecutive; the Gegenstand cells read 'm. Holzfigur' and 'w.' followed by a ditto mark repeating 'Holzfigur'. The bracketed noun in the second claim is an editorial expansion of that ditto mark. Herkunft is written 'Polynesien, Osterinsel' and repeated by ditto marks for the second entry. The abbreviations are not expanded. The HAI page states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; the scan is preserved for source evidence only.
